in_sanskrit.name: निमाय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the aim, goal, or intention of someone. It is also the name of the second avatar of Lord Krishna, who appeared to the great sage Vyasadeva as a child to teach him the Vedas.

in_marathi.name: Nimai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nimai is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Nimitta'. It means 'one who is a learned scholar or a wise man'. It is a name of Lord Krishna, who is known as 'Nimai' or 'Nimaiya', signifying his divine wisdom and knowledge.
